title: Monthly Amplify cost check: Cost Explorer by USAGE_TYPE and linked account, budget alert learned from history
description:
Repo: AnthusAI/Papyrus, `infra/` (new small CDK stack or a `papyrus-infra cost amplify` command plus an AWS Budget). Accounts: papyrus-production 712236451410, legacy 335163751677, chatticus-staging, cyclotron-production; DataParade organization still unchecked (SSO expired 2026-10-31).
Steps:
1. `papyrus-infra cost amplify [--months 3]`: Cost Explorer `GetCostAndUsage` grouped by `USAGE_TYPE` and `LINKED_ACCOUNT`, filtered to service AWS Amplify, monthly granularity; prints minutes, $ and the per-app split (via `aws amplify list-jobs` durations) so the next month's check takes one command. Read-only.
2. Alert without a fixed cap: an AWS Budget (cost, monthly, filter service=Amplify) whose threshold is derived by the IaC from the trailing 3-month median × a learned factor (start with the data: October is the baseline; after the changes land, re-baseline), with an SNS email subscription whose address comes from SSM/config (no emails in the repo). Alternative: CloudWatch anomaly detection on the `Amplify` billing metric (needs billing metrics enabled in us-east-1). Recommended default: AWS Budget with the median-derived threshold, re-derived monthly by the command above.
3. A monthly scheduled check (GitHub Actions `schedule` in Papyrus with OIDC read-only role, or Ryan's existing scheduled-tasks) that posts the table to the Kanbus epic as a comment.
Acceptance: the command returns October's numbers matching today's figures ($70.77 / 7,077 min for papyrus-production); the budget exists (CDK write, Ryan's approval); Gherkin "threshold is derived from history, not a constant".
